portfolio.title: Outstanding bachelor’s Thesis 2023/2024
portfolio.reason: At the end of the thesis work, my group and I were nominated for and won the Outstanding Bachelor Thesis Award for our significant perspective on the visually impaired and our theoretical and managerial contributions.

portfolio.title: Bachelor Thesis
portfolio.descriptiveTitle: Visual impaired people and their experience in Supermarkets
portfolio.reason: After making the group. Our group wanted to write something about both customer experience like our porgam is named, but also somehting outside the box. What we came up with and wrote about was about Visually impaired people. And their speicif relations to the mundane/continous supermarkets.

portfolio.title: Social media-ambassador
portfolio.reason: I got the most unique experience of being a social media ambassador at Lnu. I got to post ideas, collab with students. Present, showcase and lift up student, programs and the general student lifestule. Link to the full project for authenticity.

portfolio.title: Mentor for university program
portfolio.reason: Blender Foundation initiated this open movie project. A small team (7) of the best 3D artists and developers in the Blender community have been invited to come together to work in Amsterdam from October 2007 until April 2008 on completing a short 3D animation movie.

portfolio.title: Podcast host and editor
portfolio.descriptiveTitle: Creative way to show course work
portfolio.reason: When I did a course in project marketting I was challenged by the professor to show my group work through other means besides traditional presentation. What I came up with was to show the group work through a podcast. With music, an ad and asking questions to my group mates. It was my first step into the editing space. Music, script writing and also play the role as host.
